gloss: number of digits; number of figures

definitions.gloss: number of digits; number of figures
definitions.explanation: The count of digits in a number. Also used figuratively to describe something being on an entirely different scale ({桁数|けたすう}が{違|ちが}う).

examples.japanese: パスワードの{桁数|けたすう}を{増|ふ}やした。
examples.english: I increased the number of digits in my password.

examples.japanese: {桁数|けたすう}が{多|おお}いほどセキュリティが{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: The more digits there are, the higher the security.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{桁数|けたすう}が{去年|きょねん}とは{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The sales figures are on a completely different scale from last year.

notes:
Composed of {桁|けた} (digit; order of magnitude) + {数|すう} (number; count). Frequently used in technology contexts (passwords, PIN codes, data) as well as in business when discussing figures and amounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桁数|けたすう}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase the number of digits
- {桁数|けたすう}が{違|ちが}う: to be on a different order of magnitude
- {桁数|けたすう}{制限|せいげん}: digit limit
- {有効|ゆうこう}{桁数|けたすう}: significant figures (in math/science)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {桁|けた}: digit; order of magnitude — the base word, also used in {桁|けた}が{違|ちが}う
- {位|くらい}: place (ones, tens, etc.) — the positional value of a digit
- {文字数|もじすう}: character count — similar concept but counts characters, not just digits
